decision.text: New agents should receive current system state and follow the root-to-active-module readme chain; worktree verification must account for separate server/data-path behavior.
Worktrees are requested as safe UI-change sandboxes, not as independent Servex/data environments; keep verification scoped to the target UI.
Master mastermind is the system architect: supervises agent workflow, resolves operational issues, and improves system architecture; smart assistants only refine and route owner requests.
Treat current integrated Servex/Whisper/Dictate setup as a recoverable baseline; explore templates and an isolated michael/dev branch for configuration experiments.

Source-control safety direction: inventory dirty shared-tree changes first; do new work in clean separate worktrees, commit completed work, and push regularly to preserve rollback history and backups.
AI system architecture spans client, Server, Servex, and local/cloud AI providers; server-behavior experiments may need an isolated server fork distinct from UI worktrees.
Spawn denial is hardcoded: voice smart session IDs fall through Policy.kind() to worker, whose spawn rule allows only minion/helper; desired narrow permission is voice-smart→task-mastermind only.

Owner 2026-10-09: a spawn/worktree failure is a system failure and needs a standing owner who can fix it; also wants a skill for a system-architecture mastermind that reads all skills and the files they reference to understand the whole system (none exists; servex-mastermind skill only improves skills). Worktree fix: task-mastermind-worktree-pool-ready.
